decision.reason: The current successor already binds the blue/gold index atmosphere and cool count pair through one F0 route token registry. The photographic deck is the reusable InterestClubCard family, not an alternate route palette. Four remaining white-alpha decorative literals are source normalization, not a product choice.

consumer_boundary.club_card_edit_kind: bounded deterministic substitution of four exact color literals
preserve: all club projection and verification semantics
index hero composition and blue/gold atmosphere
photographic veil, scheduled-activity orange and keyboard behavior
cover loading, links and responsive layout
forbid: mapping club identity colors to generic status roles
merging the route intro palette with the photographic card palette
changing card anatomy or event data

strict_gate.required_after: F0 source integration plus the four A0 substitutions
browser_expectations: index intro and mobile shelf retain current computed colors and geometry
card fallback orbit and fact dividers are pixel-equivalent
catalog-grid and arrow-right glyphs remain 16px inline role icons
no new raw club palette owner appears

rollback.trigger: computed palette drift, missing semantic token, or change to card/index behavior
rollback.action: revert only the consumer substitutions and/or this source unit; preserve the already-centralized current index route and immutable previews

runtime_boundary.classification: historical valid transaction that predates the current centralized route and this residual binding
runtime_boundary.required_next: fresh-real exact successor containing this F0 source and the A0 substitutions, followed by independent V0 computed-style review
